title: Implement step pages and completion flow
description: Add step flattening, section-title mapping, per-step ingredient display, paged navigation, swipe-driven `TabView` integration, and the trailing done page for cook mode.
acceptance_criteria: Cook mode flattens `.step` content across recipe sections in declaration order and skips free-text content.
Each step page shows the correct section-based title fallback, step progress, rendered step text, and step-specific ingredients derived from `ingredientIndices()`.
A paged `TabView` drives step navigation with Previous/Next buttons sharing the same selected index.
The page sequence ends with a completion screen that dismisses the full-screen flow via `Done`.

handoff_summary.completed: All four acceptance criteria met: (1) flattenSteps() collects only .step content in declaration order across all sections, skipping .text; (2) each step page shows section-based title fallback, step progress (N of M in bottom nav), RecipeStepCombiner step text, and step ingredients from ingredientIndices(); (3) TabView with .page style shares $currentPage with Previous/Next buttons; (4) done page at index steps.count dismisses the fullScreenCover via @Environment(\.dismiss).
handoff_summary.remaining: Nothing for this bead. Follow-up beads (tester, documentation, review) are auto-created by the scheduler.
handoff_summary.risks: The SourceKit "No such module CookbookCore" diagnostic is cosmetic — it fires because xcodegen must be run before SourceKit resolves the SPM package. The xcodebuild build verified the code compiles correctly.
handoff_summary.next_action: Scheduler auto-creates tester and review child beads.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: CookModeIngredientList.swift was not modified; downstream agents should treat it as stable. CookModeView.swift had a one-line change (removed placeholder, inserted StepsPhase call) — low conflict risk.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Section title shown as prominent label inside the step page content (not as the nav bar title) to avoid requiring a binding back to CookModeView. Navigation bar title stays as recipe title throughout the steps phase. Step counter shown only in the bottom nav bar (N / M) to avoid duplication with the in-page section label. CookModeDonePage hides the nav bar controls and presents its own Done button. scaledRecipe is passed to StepsPhase with scale:.one for CookModeIngredientList rendering to avoid double-scaling; the original RecipeScale is passed separately only for the header label.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: Tests for: gather→steps phase transition; Previous/Next enable state at boundaries (page 0 and done page); step count; done page dismissal. These should be in CookModeViewTests.swift — created by the tester bead.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: Free-text (.text) content between steps is silently skipped per spec — no UI affordance. Timer items in step text are rendered as plain text (name + quantity) via RecipeStepCombiner, not as interactive timers (deferred to future spec). Swipe past the done page is blocked by TabView — the done page is the last tab, so there's nothing to swipe to.

conflict_risks: CookModeIngredientList.swift was not modified; downstream agents should treat it as stable. CookModeView.swift had a one-line change (removed placeholder, inserted StepsPhase call) — low conflict risk.

execution_history.summary: Implemented step pages and completion flow for cook mode. Created CookModeStepView.swift with StepsPhase (paged TabView navigator), CookModeStepPage (per-step view with section title, step text via RecipeStepCombiner, and step-specific ingredients), and CookModeDonePage (completion screen with dismiss). Updated CookModeView.swift to replace the placeholder with StepsPhase. Build compiles clean.
